Paros sits right in the heart of the Cyclades, which makes it one of the easiest Greek islands to reach — by ferry from Athens, by plane, or by island-hopping from Mykonos, Santorini and Naxos. This 2026 guide covers every route, journey time and tip you need for a smooth arrival, plus how to get from the port or airport to your hotel once you land.

![A ferry arriving at Parikia port on Paros, with the island's iconic windmill.](/media/2026/06/paros-ferry-port-1.png.webp)A ferry arriving at Parikia port on Paros, with the island’s iconic windmill.

## Where Is Paros?

Paros lies in the central Aegean, roughly 160 km southeast of Athens, between Mykonos to the north and Santorini to the south, and just across a narrow channel from Naxos. Its central location makes it a natural hub for Cyclades island hopping.

## How to Get to Paros by Ferry

### From Athens (Piraeus and Rafina)

Most travellers reach Paros by ferry from **Пирей**, the main port of Athens. High-speed ferries take roughly 3 to 3.5 hours, while conventional (slower, cheaper, steadier) ferries take about 4 to 5 hours. Ferries also depart from **Rafina** port, which is closer to Athens International Airport. Book early for July and August, when sailings sell out.

### From other islands

- Mykonos to Paros: about 45 minutes by high-speed ferry.
- Naxos to Paros: roughly 30–45 minutes — the shortest hop.
- Santorini to Paros: about 2 to 3 hours depending on the boat.
- Ios to Paros: around 1.5 to 2 hours.

Book a rental car for free pickup right at Parikia port. Step off the ferry and start exploring Paros in minutes.

## How to Get to Paros by Plane

Paros National Airport (airport code **PAS**) sits near Alyki in the south of the island. There are frequent short domestic flights from Athens (about 35–40 minutes), with extra seasonal routes in summer. Flying saves time but books up fast, so reserve ahead. There are currently no direct international flights to Paros — most visitors fly into Athens and connect by plane or ferry.

![View of a Cyclades island approaching from the deck of a ferry.](/media/2026/06/paros-ferry-deck.png.webp)View of a Cyclades island approaching from the deck of a ferry.

## From Paros Airport or Port to Your Hotel

Once you arrive, you have a few options to reach your accommodation:

- Rental car — the most flexible. Pick yours up directly at the airport or port and drive straight to your hotel. See our [Paros airport & port car hire](https://antiparosrentacar.com/ru/%d0%b0%d1%8d%d1%80%d0%be%d0%bf%d0%be%d1%80%d1%82-%d0%bf%d0%b0%d1%80%d0%be%d1%81-%d0%b0%d1%80%d0%b5%d0%bd%d0%b4%d0%b0-%d0%b0%d0%b2%d1%82%d0%be%d0%bc%d0%be%d0%b1%d0%b8%d0%bb%d0%b5%d0%b9-%d0%bf%d0%be/) page.
- Taxi — available but limited in number, especially late at night.
- Bus — budget-friendly but tied to timetables and not ideal with luggage.

Picking up a [арендовать машину на Паросе](https://antiparosrentacar.com/ru/%d0%b0%d1%80%d0%b5%d0%bd%d0%b4%d0%b0-%d0%b0%d0%b2%d1%82%d0%be%d0%bc%d0%be%d0%b1%d0%b8%d0%bb%d0%b5%d0%b9-%d0%b2-%d0%bf%d0%b0%d1%80%d0%be%d1%81%d0%b5/) on arrival means no waiting for taxis and total freedom from day one. Browse the [автопарк](https://antiparosrentacar.com/ru/%d0%b0%d0%b2%d1%82%d0%be%d0%bf%d0%b0%d1%80%d0%ba/) to choose your vehicle.

## Как добраться до Антипароса

To reach Antiparos, travel to Pounta on the west coast of Paros and take the small car ferry — the crossing is just about 7 minutes and runs very frequently in summer. In high season there are also direct boats from Parikia. See our [Antiparos island guide](https://antiparosrentacar.com/ru/%d0%be%d1%81%d1%82%d1%80%d0%be%d0%b2-%d0%b0%d0%bd%d1%82%d0%b8%d0%bf%d0%b0%d1%80%d0%be%d1%81/) и [Прокат автомобилей на Антипаросе](https://antiparosrentacar.com/ru/%d0%b0%d1%80%d0%b5%d0%bd%d0%b4%d0%be%d0%b2%d0%b0%d1%82%d1%8c-%d0%bc%d0%b0%d1%88%d0%b8%d0%bd%d1%83-%d0%b0%d0%bd%d1%82%d0%b8%d0%bf%d0%b0%d1%80%d0%be%d1%81-%d0%b0%d0%b3%d0%b3%d0%b5%d0%bb%d0%be%d1%81/) for the full picture.

## Tips for a Smooth Arrival

- Book ferries and flights early for July, August and holiday weekends.
- Coming from Athens airport? Rafina port is closer than Piraeus.
- Reserve your rental car before you travel to lock in the best rate.
- Save your ferry e-ticket offline — signal can be patchy on board.
- Read our [travel tips for Paros and Antiparos](https://antiparosrentacar.com/ru/%d1%81%d0%be%d0%b2%d0%b5%d1%82%d1%8b-%d0%bf%d1%83%d1%82%d0%b5%d1%88%d0%b5%d1%81%d1%82%d0%b2%d0%b5%d0%bd%d0%bd%d0%b8%d0%ba%d0%b0%d0%bc-%d0%bf%d0%be-%d0%b0%d0%bd%d1%82%d0%b8%d0%bf%d0%b0%d1%80%d0%be/) before you go.

## Часто задаваемые вопросы

**How do you get to Paros from Athens?**

The most common way is the ferry from Piraeus (about 3 to 5 hours) or Rafina port. You can also fly from Athens to Paros National Airport in roughly 35 to 40 minutes.

**Does Paros have an airport?**

Yes. Paros National Airport (PAS) is near Alyki in the south of the island and handles frequent domestic flights from Athens, plus extra seasonal routes. There are no direct international flights.

**How long is the ferry from Athens to Paros?**

High-speed ferries take about 3 to 3.5 hours from Piraeus, while conventional ferries take roughly 4 to 5 hours.

**How do you get from Mykonos or Santorini to Paros?**

Mykonos to Paros is about 45 minutes by high-speed ferry, and Santorini to Paros takes roughly 2 to 3 hours depending on the boat.

**What is the best way to get around once you arrive?**

Renting a car gives you the most freedom. AGGELOS Rentals Rent a Car offers free pickup at Paros airport and port so you can start exploring immediately.
